text: An example of early 20th century Edwardian-style apartment buildings, Spadina Gardens Apartments at 41 and 45 Spadina Road contribute significantly to the character of the surrounding neighbourhood.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed the Senior Manager, Heritage Preservation Services, to research and evaluate the properties at 41 and 45 Spadina Road (Spadina Gardens Apartments) according to provincial criteria Regulation 9/06, to gain a better understanding of Spadina Gardens Apartments' cultural heritage value as a rare early and intact example of a Toronto apartment building. The Spadina Gardens Apartments were completed in 1906 and listed on the City's Inventory of Heritage Properties in 1979.
